review: Inspected generated originals at 1024×1536, hands and props enlarged, and recent comparison contact sheet.

forms.light: Slim brown single-layer silhouette; complete halo and boots in frame, both relaxed hands have separate thumb and four fingers.
forms.heavy: Broad stacked shoulder/chest/thigh plates enlarge silhouette; face/bangs and open hands match light.
forms.mobility: Swept separate panels and compact shoulder/hip/calf thrusters; same slim body and bare upper-arm areas.
forms.opened: Moon, ruined arch, halo center, face, hands and boot locations match each corresponding closed image; green gaps expose inner surfaces, no weapons.

direction.evidence: Torso and pelvis face the window to image-right in side profile; shoulder rests against stone jamb.

expression.evidence: Eyes gaze slightly upward, inner brows lift gently and lips part with a subdued wistful expression.

scene.evidence: Blue moonlight through window, curtain and stone bedroom; fingertips contact sill.

outfit.evidence: Opaque bronze narrow-strap slip, straight upper-thigh hem and pale wing embroidery; small circular pendant, no halo or armor hair ornament.

hands.evidence: Near hand rests on sill with four fingers and thumb; far hand partially occluded behind it without extra digits.

casual1.actual_framing: head to upper thighs, wider than selected waist-up

direction.evidence: Camera sees top of hair, shoulders and upward-facing open book from above.

expression.evidence: Brows slightly inward, steady eyes lowered to the page, mouth closed.

scene.evidence: Cotton-gloved hand lifts an illustrated insect page; other steadies book; shallow specimen tray sits lower-right among archive drawers.

outfit.evidence: Taupe high-collar blouse with long cuffed sleeves beneath brown waistcoat; halo and metallic hair feather removed.

hands.evidence: White gloved thumb/index pinch paper edge while fingers curl behind; opposite hand spreads naturally beside page.

casual2.actual_framing: head to waist and book surface, wider than chest-up

direction.evidence: Pelvis follows forward step while upper torso turns toward viewer; open raincoat swings to image-right.

expression.evidence: Relaxed brows and slightly open exhaling mouth; gaze softened.

scene.evidence: Clear rain-beaded umbrella, reflective stone lane at dusk; free fingers touch wrist loop at handle.

outfit.evidence: Gray V-neck blouse, separate cinnamon knee skirt, long ivory open raincoat and ankle boots; tiny ring earring.

hands.evidence: One hand grips umbrella shaft, other manipulates narrow strap with thumb/index; fingers have distinct joint shapes.

diversity: Compared final three against Nincada, Empoleon and Slaking originals. Side-profile bronze slip against stone window, high-angle archive page work in cuffed blouse/waistcoat and full-length moving raincoat/umbrella have distinct activity, garment silhouette and camera. No repeated seated hobby/cafe/pool trio.
